Cutest Pokémon in the World[edit]

Use Cut to reach the tall grass patch. Speak to the woman here, and she asks if you know which Pokémon is the cutest in the world. According to her, that title belongs to Chansey, and nothing can be done to change her mind. If you speak to her again with a Chansey in the party, she gives out a Lucky Punch.

Chasing the Aurora[edit]

As you move northward along the road, you run across Suicune yet again, standing out among the waves. It flees like usual, racing northward over the water's surface. Eusine arrives a moment later, and states that he is beginning to understand what the legendary beast may be hoping to find. He would rather keep the info to himself, but wants to prove himself an honest Trainer to Suicune, and so shares the clue with you. According to him, Suicune prefers a hilly place near water, somewhere north. He is not sure exactly where just yet, and challenges you to see who can find the place first.

Fishing Guru 3[edit]

The house to the south of the intersection with Route 11 is home to the Fishing Guru's younger brother. Speak to him to receive the Super Rod. This high-end fishing rod is the best model available and can reel in some of the strongest sea creatures.
